title: 含耦合电感的网孔电流法
tags: 含耦合电感的正弦稳态
statement: U̇_s = 25∠0° V（有效值），ω = 100 rad/s，R_1 = 1 Ω，R_2 = 3 Ω。L_1 = 70 mH 在两个网孔的公共支路上，L_2 = 10 mH 在右网孔的右侧支路上，二者互感 M = 20 mH，同名端都在上端。
取网孔电流 İ_1、İ_2 均为顺时针（分别等于 R_1、R_2 中的电流，方向如图），列网孔方程，求 İ_1、İ_2 和 L_1 支路电流 İ_3 的有效值。

questions.ask: L_1 支路电流 I_3 = ?（有效值）

hints: 先写每个线圈的电压：U̇_L1 = jωL_1·İ_3 + jωM·İ_L2，U̇_L2 = jωL_2·İ_L2 + jωM·İ_3，其中 İ_3 = İ_1 − İ_2、İ_L2 = İ_2（都从同名端流入）。
把它们代入两个网孔的 KVL。网孔 2 的自阻抗里，L_1、L_2 一个顺、一个逆着同名端，互感项是 −2jωM；互阻抗是 −j(ωL_1 − ωM)。
solution: **1. 线圈电压。** 两个线圈中向下的电流都从同名端流入：L_1 中为 İ_1 − İ_2，L_2 中为 İ_2。U̇_L1 = j7(İ_1 − İ_2) + j2İ_2，U̇_L2 = j1·İ_2 + j2(İ_1 − İ_2)。
**验算（功率）：** 电源 P = 25 × 5 × cos 36.87° = 100 W；R_1 消耗 25 W，R_2 消耗 75 W，合计 100 W ✓。（也可用 T 形去耦：L_1、L_2 下端都接地，同侧，去耦后为 L_1 − M、L_2 − M 和公共支路 M。）

en.title: Mesh analysis with coupled inductors
statement: U̇_s = 25∠0° V (rms), ω = 100 rad/s, R_1 = 1 Ω, R_2 = 3 Ω. L_1 = 70 mH is in the branch shared by the two meshes and L_2 = 10 mH is in the right-hand branch of the right mesh; their mutual inductance is M = 20 mH, both dots at the top.
With clockwise mesh currents İ_1 and İ_2 (equal to the currents in R_1 and R_2, as drawn), write the mesh equations and find the rms values of İ_1, İ_2 and the current İ_3 in L_1.

questions.explain: Phase 90° − 36.87° − 53.13° = 0°: İ_2 is in phase with U̇_s.
İ_3 = İ_1 − İ_2 = (4 − j3) − 5 = −1 − j3 A, I_3 = √10 ≈ 3.162 A. Subtract phasors, not rms values (5 − 5 ≠ 3.16).

hints: First write each coil's voltage: U̇_L1 = jωL_1·İ_3 + jωM·İ_L2, U̇_L2 = jωL_2·İ_L2 + jωM·İ_3, with İ_3 = İ_1 − İ_2 and İ_L2 = İ_2 (both entering the dots).

Substitute them into the two mesh KVL equations. In mesh 2's self-impedance, L_1 and L_2 are traversed one with and one against the dots, so the mutual term is −2jωM; the mutual impedance between the meshes is −j(ωL_1 − ωM).
ωL_1 = 7 Ω, ωL_2 = 1 Ω, ωM = 2 Ω.
solution: **1. Coil voltages.** The downward currents enter both coils at their dots: İ_1 − İ_2 in L_1 and İ_2 in L_2. U̇_L1 = j7(İ_1 − İ_2) + j2İ_2, U̇_L2 = j1·İ_2 + j2(İ_1 − İ_2).

**Check (power):** the source delivers P = 25 × 5 × cos 36.87° = 100 W; R_1 takes 25 W and R_2 75 W, 100 W in total ✓. (The T equivalent also works: L_1 and L_2 both have their lower ends on ground, same side, giving L_1 − M, L_2 − M and a common branch M.)
